column7: #3488 (ATOMIC-OWED-1): SetUserRoles removed roles one by one, then granted fail closed; with role.assigned refused the compensating re-grant (AssignUserRole) failed closed too, so the user lost a role and the error said "nothing was changed". The replacement is now a split mixed request (role_set_replace.go): removals in one owed transaction, additions in one fail-closed transaction, no re-grant; a failed addition after removals is a PartialMutationError. This test reads the role set under a role.assigned-only fault and a total outage (SQLite and PostgreSQL); TestSetProjectMemberRole_AuditOutage_NeverStrandsOrLies covers the sibling (and the sole-admin swap that used to strand the project); server/faultops TestOwedAuditSplit_SweepEverySplitOp gains both routes. Red on main 7e670da83: mixed cases of both ops, the sole-admin swap (project left with no administrator), and both new split scenarios (the audit log blocked the narrowing).
